name: Hammers 💥
desc:
Hammers 💥 is a game where BLUNT-HEAVY OBJECTS are used to smack and fling your opponents🔥.  ⚠️ Large objects on sticks are considered to be Hammers, do not be surprised if you're fighting some guy with cheese on a stick! 

[BETA] - THIS GAME IS STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT! Some things are subject to change, Expect Bugs! 

Controls 🎮:
[F] - To use Ability (B for Console)  
[E] - To use another feature  (Y for Console)
[Q] - To use another feature (X for Console)

⚠️ Exploiting = Permanent Ban!!
